source_basis: stake verb + loss/slash state + per-user write + same-block-only guard
observed: new stake records/incurs loss state with only a same-block loss guard
expected: exclude prior-block loss from a new stake (init checkpoint AND guard prior losses, not only same-block)
attacker_path: actor stakes after a loss/deficit exists in the same gauge/term
impact_delta: a staker can be slashed for / inherit a pre-existing (prior-block) loss
victim_gainer: new staker loses value; existing deficit is subsidized
invariant_break: a staker can be slashed for / inherit a pre-existing (prior-block) loss
assertion: stake after a seeded prior-block loss; assert the new position is slashed / valued below an initialized-checkpoint control
control_refutation: control: a stake with full prior-loss exclusion (init checkpoint + guard prior losses) is NOT slashed
tx_sequence: 1) seed a prior-block gauge loss (lastGaugeLoss < block.timestamp); 2) victim stakes into that gauge; 3) the same-block guard passes but the prior loss applies -> immediate slash
